names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 14454, «Тамара (Сатси), игумения, прмц.», with the rank words left off. The day’s own line declines the forename and prints no surname at all, «Прмц. Тамары (1942)».

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru closes her line with: «Прмц. Тамары (1942)». It is the only year either page gives.

feast.note: Her name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of the Russian Church. One row per church is the schema, so that day is recorded here and she does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 18 апреля ст. ст. — «Прмц. Тамары (1942).»

attestations.note: The calendar’s line is all there is: no life page on the day page and none on name page 14454, and no place, no house, no arrest and no manner of death. The name page knows one thing the line does not, that she was an igumena, and that is what `abbess` stands on; no `office` is written, because the locale packs carry no Abbess. «26 января (Новомуч.)» on her name page is what `new-martyr` stands on. azbyka.ru was not read.
